alternatives_rejected.why: Frontend latency deviations (z=25.95 p50, z=20.93 p90) are an order of magnitude smaller than currencyservice's z=179.34 (E1). This fits frontend waiting on the 8.42x slower inbound currency calls (E2), not an independent frontend fault.
Only checkout p90 moved (z=14.1, E1), the weakest signal on the board. Checkout calls currencyservice, so this matches propagation of the inbound currency delay seen in E2.

proposed_fix.description: Remove the injected network delay affecting currencyservice traffic (e.g., delete the tc/netem or chaos rule on its pod or interface), then confirm caller-observed currency latency returns to about 5ms p50.
